lines.zh: 我八条腿一起动，地面在响。
lines.en: Eight legs move at once and the ground rings.

lines.zh: 我这身肉和铁压得很沉。
lines.en: This body of flesh and iron weighs a great deal.

lines.zh: 我走过墙根，墙皮掉下来。
lines.en: I pass a wall and the plaster falls.

lines.zh: 我的腿弯得很高，像拱门。
lines.en: My legs arch high like doorways.
My legs bend and then hoist me up.

lines.zh: 我踩过一堆碎石，全压平了。
lines.en: I cross a heap of rubble and flatten it.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，沟更深了。
lines.en: The trench deepens wherever I walk.

lines.zh: 我转过身，整片地都暗了。
lines.en: I turn and the ground goes dark.

lines.zh: 我沿着沟渠走，把沟填平了。
lines.en: I walk the ditch and fill it in.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，一步一步稳着来。
lines.en: I count my steps and keep them sure.

lines.zh: 我停着，腿还在一颤一颤。
lines.en: I stop, and my legs still twitch.

lines.zh: 我头上那层壳一动不动。
lines.en: The shell over my head doesn't move.

lines.zh: 周围的水汽在我身上凝。
lines.en: The damp condenses on me.
I'm listening for a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我的每条腿都占住一块地。
lines.en: Each of my legs claims a patch of ground.
This stretch of ground is mine to keep.

lines.zh: 我把前腿抬起来又放下。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg and set it down.
The tubes on my body gurgle.
I'm in no hurry; prey comes to me.
I rotate my head slowly.
My marks stay in the ground.

lines.zh: 我从上面看下去，什么都很小。
lines.en: From up here, everything looks small.
The air here is close and heavy.
I breathe out a little white vapor.
Something moves on my back.

lines.zh: 我把腿收了一收，占的地方更小。
lines.en: I draw my legs in to take less room.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: You're too close; I see you clearly.
Seeing me like this, you should back off.
My shadow touches you before I do.

lines.zh: 你握得越紧，我越看得清。
lines.en: The tighter you grip it, the clearer I see.
I have more than one pair of eyes.
There's no way behind you, is there.
I lift a leg and my shadow covers you.
Your breath shakes against my leg.
I don't shout; I simply act.

lines.zh: 你要么现在跑，要么永远留下。
lines.en: Run now, or stay forever.

lines.zh: 我一低头，你就躲进阴影。
lines.en: I lower my head and you shrink into shadow.
You have one blow left in you.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，压塌了一面墙。
lines.en: One step back and a wall collapses.

lines.zh: 这一下钻进了我的甲缝。
lines.en: That one slipped into a seam.
I hiss and a tube vents.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，血从壳缝里出来。
lines.en: I raise my head, blood seeping from shell seams.
The wound is in my armor seam, itching.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了半截腿。
lines.en: That cost me half a leg.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地面跟着塌。
lines.en: Half a step back and the ground caves.

lines.zh: 我身上的水变成了红的。
lines.en: The water on me turns red.
I slowly turn back around.
My armor is cracked; my legs have not buckled.
Things like that I never touch.
You hold it up; I spare it a look.
I sweep it aside with a leg.

lines.zh: 这点东西连我的牙缝都填不满。
lines.en: That wouldn't fill a gap in my teeth.
My hunger isn't that kind.
I crush it underfoot.
That won't buy me off.
I prefer things that run.
Stop waving it; it irritates me.
It tastes thin as water.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，我连颤都没颤。
lines.en: You hit my leg and I don't even twitch.
You set my plates ringing.

lines.zh: 我抬腿让了让，你差点被踩。
lines.en: I lift a leg to spare you from being crushed.
You're thrown back and roll twice.
That impact cost me not one step.

lines.zh: 碎石被我们撞得到处飞。
lines.en: Rubble flies everywhere.
You're lighter than I thought.
I look down and want very much to step.
That won't make me change feet.
I do not even lower my head.

lines.zh: 八条腿和八条腿并在一起。
lines.en: Eight legs draw up beside eight legs.
Her plates are redder than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起把地面压出一片坑。
lines.en: Together we sink a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 她没有说话，只是转过来。
lines.en: She says nothing; she only turns.
Our shadows merge into one mass.
Her tubes pulse faster than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，占满整条路。
lines.en: We stand abreast and fill the road.
The ground is still shaking as she leaves.
We divide this ground between us.
Neither of us stands taller.
I pinch it up with a foreleg.
A corner breaks off in my grip.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，掉进缝里了。
lines.en: It's so small it's lost between plates.
I lift it, look, and throw it away.
I grind it into the rubble.
I can't pick it up at all.
I grind it to powder.
It's shorter than my leg.
This is no prize.
I sweep it aside and walk on.

lines.zh: 我的心跳快了一拍，找到了。
lines.en: My pulse jumps once — found it.

lines.zh: 我把头转过去，八条腿撑开。
lines.en: I turn my head and spread my eight legs.

lines.zh: 你在这片地上跑不掉的。
lines.en: You won't leave this ground.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一个接一个盯住你。
lines.en: My eyes fix on you, one after another.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛都对着一个方向。
lines.en: Every eye I have points one way.

lines.zh: 这一带的地形我摸清了。
lines.en: I've learned the ground here.

lines.zh: 你挡在路中间，那就先踩你。
lines.en: You stand in the road; you'll be stepped on first.
I don't roar; it wastes breath.
I lower myself, legs bending.
Wherever you retreat, I follow.
I have you locked down.
Now I give you one chance.
Let's see how many hits you take.

lines.zh: 这一片的尘土都是我扬起来的。
lines.en: The dust here is all mine to raise.

lines.zh: 我把两条前腿都抬起来。
lines.en: I raise both forelegs.
My leg is on your way out.

lines.zh: 我的腿把出口全堵上了。
lines.en: My legs have sealed every exit.
Done counting. Begin.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，很慢。
lines.en: I press forward, very slowly.
You back to a wall; it's too low.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿横在你前面。
lines.en: I lay a leg across your path.

lines.zh: 你砍我一条腿，我还有七条。
lines.en: Cut a leg off and I still have seven.
I lower my head and my teeth are close.
You weave between my legs.
Chasing you this far needs no run.

lines.zh: 我抬起两条前腿，准备压下来。
lines.en: I lift two forelegs to come down.
Dust wraps half of me.
You're out of strength already.
You're under my shadow.
Only my legs are left behind you.

lines.zh: 这一片地面已经开始裂了。
lines.en: The ground here is starting to crack.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能踩到你。
lines.en: A little closer and I can step on you.
Watch which leg comes down first.

lines.zh: 我已经挑好落下的地方。
lines.en: I've chosen where to put my foot.
This one will be heavy.

lines.zh: 我把整副重量压下来了。
lines.en: I bring my whole weight down.
This one ends it.
This is as far as your road goes.
One leg comes down.

lines.zh: 我的腿落下去，石板碎了。
lines.en: My leg comes down; the flagstones shatter.

lines.zh: 我用前腿横扫，把你推开。
lines.en: A sweep of my foreleg shoves you back.

lines.zh: 我低头咬，牙齿咬合了两次。
lines.en: I bite twice and my teeth meet.

lines.zh: 你砍在我甲上，只留一道痕。
lines.en: Your blade leaves one white line.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的护甲往下压。
lines.en: I press down on your armor.
It puts you flat.
Another leg lifts.

lines.zh: 你躲开了，我的腿扎进土里。
lines.en: You dodge; my leg drives into the dirt.
I lift you and throw you down.
Blood sprays my leg.
You're still moving; again.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，把碎石扫向你。
lines.en: I turn and sweep rubble at you.
You're pinned at the wall.
My teeth close on your shoulder.
You've finally stopped.
The ground splits first; then I rise.

lines.zh: 八条腿撑开，把土都推开。
lines.en: Eight legs spread and shove the soil aside.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着管子和管子。
lines.en: Tubes still hang from my body.

lines.zh: 我的甲上有一层湿的东西。
lines.en: Something wet coats my plates.
I raise my head higher than the trees.
The air around grows heavy.
I set my first foot down.
This place is too small.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整块地盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers the entire plot.

lines.zh: 地底下有呼吸，我找过去。
lines.en: Breathing underground; I go toward it.

lines.zh: 我转过身，找声音的来源。
lines.en: I turn to find where the sound came from.
The shell over my head slowly opens.
Dust rises first; then I arrive.

lines.zh: 尘土跟着我一起扬起来。
lines.en: Dust rises with me.
This ground is mine now.
My legs bite the soil and hold.

lines.zh: 管子里的水还在往下滴。
lines.en: Water still drips from my tubes.
I bare my teeth; it isn't a smile.
You should have run long ago.
Though it's too late for that.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，合成一股焦味。
lines.en: Fire crawls my plates and leaves a burnt stink.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下去，八条腿撑不住。
lines.en: I fall from a height and eight legs can't hold.

lines.zh: 水没到我头顶，我挣扎着。
lines.en: Water closes over my head and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆开的光掀掉我半边甲。
lines.en: The blast tears half a plate away.

lines.zh: 一根长东西扎进我的腿。
lines.en: Something long lodges in my leg.
Spell-light works into my shell seams.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我的腿都抬不动了。
lines.en: Too starved, I can't lift my legs.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我八条腿走了一遍。
lines.en: Lightning runs down all eight legs.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我落得很慢。
lines.en: Nothing below, and I fall slowly.
